ev.q: Coverage with the updated COVID-19 vaccine among adults aged ≥65 years was 42% as of February 3, 2024
Effectiveness of an additional dose in older adults has been demonstrated for previously recommended additional original COVID-19 vaccine doses
On February 28, 2024, ACIP recommended that all persons aged ≥65 years receive 1 additional dose
In 2018, ACIP adopted the Evidence to Recommendations framework to guide the development of vaccine recommendations.
